Class FleetManagement

java.lang.Object
FleetManagement
public class FleetManagement extends Object
The Fleet Management System for the Coconut Grove Sailing Club. Loads the fleet, lets the Commodore print, add, remove, and spend money on boats, and saves the fleet on exit.
Version:
1.0 November 2026
Author:
Gracielle Boucher
